capabilities: Render Markdown notes with custom CSS themes in a live preview panel
Upload local note images to the WeChat media library automatically
Sync styled articles to the WeChat Official Account draft box in one click
Extract the first image of a note as the article cover
Copy rendered rich text to the clipboard as a fallback
disambiguation: Not a vault file-syncing tool; it publishes formatted articles to the WeChat Official Account draft box.
extras: The plugin is free and donation-supported (the author asks for small donations); the README states there is no relay server and all requests go directly from the local machine to api.weixin.qq.com, with credentials stored encrypted locally. Image preview for the default-cover picker is not yet supported. The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
motivation: The author calls automatic image upload the biggest pain point and wanted true one-click sync; the plugin is also deliberately free as a stand against paid membership tools.
problem: Publishing a styled Markdown article to WeChat Official Account normally means manual reformatting, uploading each image separately, and setting a cover by hand in the WeChat editor.

relations.evidence: 一键排版 Markdown 笔记并完美无缝同步至微信公众号草稿箱
类似于mdnice的体验，左边是ob原生的笔记编辑区，右边是实时更新的渲染预览效果

summary: Formats Markdown notes with custom CSS themes and syncs them, including images and cover, to WeChat Official Account drafts via its API.
